summary:
I verified research/sf/fp-simulator.md and research/sf/fp-physical-integration.md against the host repository at 81f1cd96 (/home/user/clausellstokes-lang/settlement-engine, read-only, no git commands). I read both notes in full, and read in full DESIGN_FP_COHERENCE_FOLD.md (708 lines) and DESIGN_ROUTE_LIFECYCLE.md (300). For every other host document, I opened each cited line range. I checked about 60 code sites at the lines the notes give. I checked about 1,250 claims: 385 tagged statements, the roughly 470 citations behind them, every stated line count (all 40 match), and the recounts.

Findings: 34. Six are WRONG (FV-01, -05, -19, -25, -26, -28), two are UNSUPPORTED (FV-29, -30) and 26 are IMPRECISE. Two candidates, FV-11 and FV-14, did not hold up on re-read; they are withdrawn with evidence.
